a third housing option

Where you can have a home, build for the future and move through life how you choose.

Our story

Scroll

Our belief

For too long, having a home has largely meant choosing between renting and buying. We believe there’s another way. One that gives people the stability of a home, the opportunity to build wealth and the freedom to move through life as it changes.

Built differently

Designed for those that believe in another way

  1. 01

    Greater access

    A lower barrier to having a home and building wealth.

  2. 02

    Build without debt

    Build wealth without taking on a traditional mortgage.

  3. 03

    Payments build value

    Your payments help build a stake in the Domo property pool.

  4. 04

    Freedom to move

    Move between Domo homes without leaving the value you’ve built behind.

  5. 05

    More taken care of

    Insurance, rates and repairs included, taking care of the essentials.

  6. 06

    Another way forward

    A new housing model designed to give people more choice.

Impact

Domo is built for individuals, but the impact it creates goes well beyond them

  1. 01

    More new homes

    Quality homes built where people live and work, helping increase supply where it’s needed.

  2. 02

    Less debt dependency

    Fewer people needing to borrow to have a home means less reliance on mortgage debt.

  3. 03

    Access to wealth

    Opening access to property wealth gives more Australians the opportunity to build financial security.

  4. 04

    A more mobile workforce

    Reducing the financial cost of moving helps people follow opportunities across cities and regions.

  5. 05

    Homes to live in

    Investment goes into homes people actually live in, putting capital to more productive use.

  6. 06

    Stronger neighbourhoods

    Stable housing and the right to stay help create communities people genuinely invest in.

how Domo works

Move into a Domo home without a deposit or mortgage, make monthly payments, and build a stake that can grow with the property pool.

How it works

Scroll

Step by step

From move-in to wealth

Four steps between where you are now and a new way home.

  1. choose your Domo home

    Find a Domo home in a location that works for you.

  2. move in

    No deposit, mortgage or bank approval. One upfront payment gets you the keys.

  3. build your stake

    Your monthly payments build your stake across the Domo property pool, not just the home you live in.

  4. stay, move or cash out

    Stay as long as you like, move to another Domo home, or cash out the value you’ve built.

No. If you stayed in the same Domo home for decades, it might look similar, but that's not what makes Domo different. Life changes, and you're not tied to one property. You can move to another Domo home and take the value you've built with you.

Domo gives you a way to have a home and build wealth without a deposit or mortgage. You can make your home your own, build value through your monthly payments and move as life changes. Plus, everyday costs like insurance, rates and repairs are taken care of.

There's no hidden catch, just a different approach to housing. Renting works for some people, buying works for others, and Domo offers a third option. You can have a home and build wealth without a deposit or mortgage. Our team will explain the costs, conditions and how it all works before you commit.

Your monthly payments build your stake in the Domo property pool. Rather than being tied to one property, your stake sits across a pool of Domo homes. As the value of the pool changes with the property market, the value of your stake can change too.

Domo is for people who want the stability of a home and the opportunity to build wealth without taking on a traditional mortgage. It could suit people who value flexibility, want to put down roots or simply want another option beyond renting and buying.

You don't need a traditional deposit or mortgage to get started with Domo. You'll need the equivalent of one month's payment upfront, with the amount depending on the home you choose. Our team will walk you through the costs before you commit.

There's no maximum length of time you need to stay in a Domo home. If you love where you live, you can put down roots and make it yours. And if life changes, you have the flexibility to move to another Domo home.

Absolutely. It's your home to live in and make your own. Paint the walls, plant a garden and create a space that feels like you. For larger changes, our team can explain what's possible under your Domo agreement.

Domo is designed to move with you. You can move to another Domo home and take the value you've built with you, rather than starting again. Or, if you're ready to leave Domo altogether, you can explore cashing out your stake.

If you decide to leave Domo, you can request to cash out your stake based on its value at the time. The process and timing will depend on your Domo agreement, and our team can explain how this works before you join.

Like any property-linked asset, the value of your stake can go up or down. With Domo, your stake sits across a pool of homes rather than one property, spreading your exposure across the pool. And you're not carrying a traditional mortgage alongside that risk.

If buying a home makes sense for you, that's a great option. Domo isn't here to replace traditional ownership or renting. It's about giving people another choice: a way to have a home and build wealth without needing a deposit or mortgage.

With a traditional property investment, you own an asset that may be separate from where you live. Domo brings your home and wealth-building opportunity together. You live in a Domo home while your monthly payments build a stake across the Domo property pool.

Domo homes are designed around a range of household needs, with modular configurations that include different bedroom, bathroom and garage options. Whether you need more space for a growing family or something simpler, you can explore the layouts available through our home builder.

Yes. Our Build your home tool lets you explore different configurations, including bedrooms, bathrooms and garage spaces. You can also select available extras, like solar panels or EV charging, to create a home that works for the way you live.

Domo is focused on creating homes in growing communities, close to the places people live, work and spend their time. Locations will depend on where homes are being developed and become available. Register your interest to stay updated.

Yes. Solar panels and EV charging are among the optional extras you can explore when configuring your Domo home. Available features will depend on your chosen home and configuration, and our team can explain what's possible.

Repairs and maintenance are taken care of as part of Domo, so you don't have to organise everything yourself. If something needs attention, you can contact the team and we'll explain the next steps. It's one less thing to manage when it comes to having a home.

That depends on the home you choose and whether it's already available or still being built. Our team will talk you through the expected timeline as part of your enquiry, so you know what to expect before making any decisions.

Your Domo home is designed to be ready to live in when you move in. You can then make it your own over time, from decorating to creating spaces that suit your life. For bigger changes, our team can explain what's possible.

With renting, your payments cover the cost of living in a property. With Domo, your monthly payments also help build a stake in the Domo property pool. You have the right to stay, the freedom to make your home your own and the flexibility to move as life changes.

Domo homes are purpose-built around the Domo model, with configurations designed for the way people live. They're intended to be quality homes that you can settle into, make your own and enjoy for as long as they suit your needs.

Domo is designed to give you the freedom to make your home your own, and that includes having pets. Any applicable conditions will be explained as part of your agreement, so you know what's possible before moving in.

Your Domo home comes finished and ready to live in, with the fixtures and fittings included in your chosen configuration. Our team will explain exactly what's included in your home before you commit, so you know what to expect on move-in day.

Your home configuration gives you a say in how your home is laid out and the features it includes. Available finishes and design choices will depend on the home, and our team can walk you through the options before you make your selections.

You can make your Domo home your own, from decorating to creating a space that suits your life. For larger changes like renovations or extensions, speak with our team first. They'll explain what's possible and any conditions that apply.

The home stays within the Domo property pool. You can move to another Domo home and take your value with you, or explore cashing out your stake if you're leaving Domo altogether. The value you've built isn't tied to staying in one particular home.

No. You don't need to save a traditional house deposit to move into a Domo home. That's one of the things that makes Domo different. You can get started without a mortgage or the large upfront costs usually associated with buying a home.

It means you don't need a traditional house deposit to get started. You'll need the equivalent of one month's Domo payment upfront, rather than saving a large lump sum. Our team will explain the amount and any other applicable costs before you commit.

As your enquiry progresses, we may ask for information about your income, employment and financial circumstances, along with proof of identity. This helps us understand whether Domo is a suitable option for you and explain the next steps.

Your financial circumstances may form part of the eligibility assessment, including your income and financial history. Our team will explain what information is required and how your application is assessed before you proceed.

We look at your circumstances to understand whether a Domo home is a suitable and sustainable option for you. This may include your income, employment and financial position. Our team will explain what's involved as your enquiry progresses.

Yes. You don't need to have owned property before to explore Domo. It's a third housing option for people who want to have a home and build wealth without following the traditional deposit and mortgage pathway.

Life changes, and we understand that circumstances can change too. If your financial situation changes, get in touch with our team as early as possible. We can talk through your circumstances and explain the options available under your agreement.

This will depend on the eligibility requirements and your individual circumstances. Our team can explain what's needed as part of your enquiry, so you'll know whether any additional information or arrangements are required.

The timing will depend on your circumstances, the information required and the availability of your chosen home. Our team will guide you through the process and keep you updated on what happens next.

Yes. Domo is designed for different households, including couples and families. Our team can explain how a joint or household application works and what information will be needed from each person.

You may need to provide proof of identity, income and employment, along with other relevant financial information. The exact requirements will depend on your circumstances, and our team will explain what to prepare as your enquiry progresses.

Yes. We handle your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Information collected during your enquiry is used and shared for the purposes explained in that policy, including assessing your eligibility and progressing your application.

Yes. Joining Domo is subject to eligibility and suitability requirements. If your application can't progress, our team can explain the outcome and any next steps available to you.

Your monthly payment will depend on the home and configuration you choose. You can explore indicative figures through our Build your home tool, and our team will provide a breakdown of the costs before you commit.

Your monthly payments are based on the home and configuration you choose. They cover your housing arrangement while also helping you build a stake in the Domo property pool. Our team can explain the payment structure and how it applies to your home.

Your monthly payments may change in accordance with your Domo agreement. The terms will explain when and how payments can be reviewed, so you'll understand what to expect before joining.

If you think you might miss a payment, contact our team as soon as possible. We can talk through your circumstances, explain what happens under your agreement and discuss any options that may be available.

Additional payment options will depend on your Domo agreement. If you're interested in building your stake faster, our team can explain whether extra contributions are available and how they would work.

No. Your monthly Domo payments help you have a home while also building a stake in the Domo property pool. Unlike ordinary rent payments, part of what you pay contributes to value that belongs to you.

Your Domo payment includes more than the cost of living in your home. Everyday property costs like insurance, rates and repairs are bundled in, giving you fewer separate expenses to manage. Our team will explain exactly what's included.

Domo works differently from a traditional mortgage, so there's no home loan to pay off. Your payments build your stake in the Domo property pool over time. If you'd like to make additional contributions, our team can explain the options available.

Domo payments are designed to be straightforward, with a regular monthly payment arrangement. Our team will explain how payments are set up and managed before you move in.

No. Monthly payments vary depending on the home and configuration you choose. You can explore indicative payments through our Build your home tool and get a clearer breakdown as your enquiry progresses.

Your payments begin contributing to your stake from the start. You don't need to stay in one Domo home for decades to begin building value. The amount available if you leave will depend on your stake's value and the terms of your agreement.

Register your interest in joining the Domo Trades network. Once you're onboarded, work can be matched to your trade, skills and location, giving you access to relevant jobs without having to find every opportunity yourself.

Domo Trades connects tradespeople with work across new home builds and ongoing property maintenance. The jobs available will depend on your trade, location and the needs of Domo homes in your area.

Domo Trades is designed to make the payment process straightforward. Our team will explain invoicing, payment terms and how the process works when you join, so you know what to expect before taking on a job.

You'll need to hold the licences, registrations and accreditations required for the work you carry out. Our team will explain the requirements for your trade as part of the onboarding process.

Domo Trades is designed to offer an ongoing pipeline of work rather than relying on individual leads. Opportunities span new builds and maintenance, although the volume of work will depend on your trade, location and demand.

Domo Trades is focused on Melbourne, with work opportunities connected to the areas where Domo homes are being built and maintained. Register your interest and our team can explain what's available in your area.

Register your interest through the For trades page. Our team will be in touch to discuss your trade, experience and location, and explain the next steps for joining the network.

Domo Trades works with a range of trades involved in building, repairing and maintaining homes. Register your interest and our team can explain the opportunities relevant to your trade and experience.

The amount of work available will depend on your trade, location and demand. Domo Trades is designed to create a more consistent pipeline of opportunities, but the volume of work may vary over time.

Domo Trades is designed to connect you with relevant work while you continue running your business. Our team can explain any availability or scheduling requirements before you join.

You'll have a Domo contact who can help with questions or issues that arise on a job. Our team will explain the process for raising concerns and getting support when you join the network.

Jobs are matched according to your trade, skills, location and availability. The aim is to connect you with work that's relevant to your experience and practical for your business to take on.

Your monthly payments help build your stake in the Domo property pool. As you continue making payments, your stake builds over time. Its value can also change with the value of the pool, giving you the opportunity to build property wealth while living in your home.

The Domo property pool is made up of Domo homes. Rather than owning the individual home you live in, you build a stake linked to the value of the pool as a whole. This means your value isn't tied to just one property.

Your stake is linked to the payments you've made and the value of the Domo property pool. Property market data helps inform the pool's valuation. Our team can explain how your stake is calculated and how changes in value are reflected.

Your stake is linked to the value of the Domo property pool, so its value can fall as well as rise. Because the pool includes multiple homes, your stake isn't dependent on the performance of one property. However, diversification doesn't remove market risk.

If you decide to leave Domo, you can request to cash out your stake based on its current value. The process, conditions and timing will be set out in your agreement and explained before you join.

No. Your stake is linked to the Domo property pool, and property values can rise or fall. While your monthly payments help build your stake, its value isn't guaranteed to increase and Domo doesn't promise a fixed return.

With traditional property investing, you generally buy an individual property as an asset. Domo works differently. You live in a Domo home while your payments build a stake across a pool of homes, bringing your housing and wealth-building opportunity together.

If you leave Domo, your stake is valued and settled according to your agreement. You can explore cashing out, or if you're moving to another Domo home, take the value you've built with you.

The Domo property pool is valued periodically using property market data. Our team can explain how often the pool is assessed and how the latest valuation affects your stake.

You'll be able to see the value of your stake and how it changes over time. This includes the value built through your payments and changes linked to the Domo property pool, so you can keep track of where you stand.

CoreLogic is a property data provider. Its market data can help inform valuations of homes in the Domo property pool, which are used in calculating the value of your stake. The data is one part of the valuation process.

If you'd like to pass your stake on to someone else, whether during your lifetime or as part of your estate, the options will depend on your Domo agreement. Our team can explain what's possible and how the process works.

what is Domo trades?

Domo Trades is our network of trusted tradespeople, working across new Domo homes and the ongoing maintenance that keeps them running.

Join once and stay part of the network, with work matched to your trade, skills and location. So instead of constantly chasing the next job, there’s another one waiting.

a new way to work

  • Consistent pipeline

    New builds and ongoing maintenance mean there’s always more work coming through.

  • Paid on time

    Clear pricing and reliable payment cycles, so you know what you’re getting and when.

  • No chasing invoices

    Payments are handled through Domo, without the follow-ups and back-and-forth.

  • Work that suits you

    Jobs matched to your trade, skills and location, so you get the right work for you.

who we’re looking for

We’re building a network of reliable trades for new Domo homes and the ongoing work that keeps them running.

  • Bricklayers
  • Carpenters
  • Concreters
  • Electricians
  • Glaziers
  • Joiners
  • Landscapers
  • Roofers
  • Tilers
  • Plumbers
  • Painters
  • Plasterers

Step by step

Four steps to steady work

  1. tell us about yourself

    Share your trade, licences, experience and where you work.

  2. get verified

    Once approved, you’ll become part of the Domo Trades network.

  3. join the network

    Once approved, you’ll become part of the Domo Trades network.

  4. get matched with work

    We’ll match you with suitable new build and maintenance jobs as they come up.

Domo

Privacy Policy

Effective date: 26 October 2026|Last updated: 26 October 2026

1. About this website

Domo is a local demonstration of a housing website. This version is not connected to the business shown in the design reference.

2. Information you submit

The registration, trade and enquiry forms collect the details you choose to provide, including your name, contact details, location and home preferences.

3. How enquiries are stored

Submitted enquiries are saved by this installation. They are not emailed to a third party or sent to the reference business. The operator of this installation is responsible for access, retention and deletion.

4. Cookies and preferences

Your cookie choices and home builder location preferences may be remembered in your browser. This installation does not include analytics, advertising trackers or email marketing integrations.

5. Media and external services

Images, fonts and videos are served locally. The supplied story film and the branded FAQ clips play from this installation.

6. Your choices

You can clear saved browser preferences using your browser settings. Contact the person operating this installation to request access to, correction of, or deletion of an enquiry.

Terms of Service

Effective date: 26 October 2026|Last updated: 26 October 2026

1. About Domo

This website is a demonstration of a housing concept. It does not offer a tenancy, property, investment product or financial service.

The home builder, comparison charts and example prices illustrate the interface. They are not a quote, valuation, forecast or guarantee.

Submitting a form records an enquiry with this installation. It does not create a membership, reservation, purchase, contract or payment obligation.

4. Website content

The content is provided for exploring the demonstration. A real service would need its own verified business information, agreements, pricing and operating arrangements.

5. Availability

This local website and its stored enquiries are managed by the person operating this installation. No availability or response time is promised.

6. Privacy
